_comment: What check-file-hygiene.mjs must not read in THIS repository. The CHECKER lives
in claude-skills (tools/check-file-hygiene.mjs) and is run by all three
repositories; the RULE travels and the exemptions stay home, so a checker three
repositories share never carries one repository's exclusion list. buses-data
OA-241 states the convention; this file arrived with OA-398.
Until 2026-09-18 this repository declared nothing and got the bare rules over
its whole tracked corpus, which was right and cost nothing. Vendoring the byte
gates' fixtures into gate-fixtures/ changed that: 45 of the 73 files are
generator output with no final newline, and they are BYTE-IDENTICAL COPIES of
files in buses-data, which excuses the same folder for the same reason. Fixing
them here would make the copy differ from its source and turn `npm run
fixtures:vendor` red for ever; excusing them keeps the copy honest.
The pattern is buses-data's own, so the same fixture is excused by the same
words on both sides of the copy.
